name: Starfall Haven
core_rationale: Primary sky-island anchorage town of Starfall Anchorage at [1, 1] built inside a crescent basalt harbor where dream-glass cartographers maintain the starlight tether-winches and guard the Inverted Belfry descent.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Luminous star-tide pools held inside carved basalt basins with upward-drifting mist

North.lock_message: Upward-pouring silver cataracts at Mirror Cascade Basin have frozen the northern tether-lock; the Cartographer Guild requires the Belfry Star-Chime before unsealing the gate.

resident_npcs.name: Anchor-Warden Lyra
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Mind your boots near the pier rim, little Sprout! Out here the ocean falls up toward the stars, so keep one hand on the 0.60 meter brass guide-rail.

resident_npcs.name: Dream-Glass Cartographer Solen
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Every floating island in the Shattered Halo orbits Vesper's sleeping heart. Help us quiet the Inverted Belfry below and I will chart the route to the Eclipse Observatory!

causal_continuity.evidence: Serves as the primary sky-harbor of Starfall Anchorage where Vesper's starlight tether-chains anchor the southern archipelago.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Lantern-lit basalt piers overlooking upward-flowing waterfalls and an inverted cathedral belfry hanging beneath the island.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Counters at 0.58 to 0.60m, basalt stair risers at 0.14m, doorways 2.20m x 1.65m, and 13.5m harbor promenades for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Symmetric West portal to hunting-area-tether-causeway, Dungeon portal to dungeon-inverted-belfry, and North fog_of_lore portal to hunting-area-mirror-cascade.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Mirror Cascade Basin gate with a fog_of_lore boundary portal and Cartographer Guild lock message.
